leadText:
An unnamed island in the Orange Islands appears in The Joy of Pokémon. According to Pocket Monsters Film Comic, it is a deserted island considered to be a part of Kinnow Island.

A particularly athletic and tanned Nurse Joy operates the local Pokémon Center. She also services a number of surrounding islands, rowing from island to island with her to help sick or injured Pokémon because most of the Orange Islands are too small to have Pokémon Centers.
